features.quote: If 80%+ of trials hit ≥5 regardless of condition, task is too hard (redesign).

Potential dual-use concerns: If this becomes a method for detecting model distress, could be used to create worse conditions (adversarial). Mitigation: Don't release code/data that makes it easy to induce degradation.
